jobs.description:
Full Stack Developer (Angular & Java)
Who we are
Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
The opportunity
At Worldline, our technology addresses the persistent challenges of the payment world. We design and operate leading digital payment and transactional solutions that enable sustainable economic growth and reinforce trust and security in our societies. If you are a highly skilled Developer who has a creative mind and passionate about delivering quality code, then get ready to join our company! We have many hardworking and dedicated peers that would love for you to work with them. We are committed to continuous improvement. We are always looking for new and innovative ways to improve quality, reduce costs, build excellent solutions, and grow customer happiness. We would like to welcome an organized, innovative and process driven colleague to our team.
Day-to-day responsibilities
Embraces new technology with passion
Responsible for writing clean, secure code, ideally following a test-driven approach
Code that others can reuse
Apply technical knowledge and experience to create or design workable prototypes and outputs
Translate user stories and propose design approaches or services to meet user needs and engage in meaningful interactions and relationships with users when required
Adopt a modern approach to standards
Apply appropriate design standards, methods and tools and ensure they are applied effectively
Collaborative, keen to share knowledge and learn continually
Think out of the box
You document all aspects of software, for ongoing maintenance and revisions
You collaborate with other IT specialists, technicians, etc., to deliver software solutions
You participate in on-going training to stay current in required skills
Who are we looking for
We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
You have 5+ years of experience in full-stack development with proficiency in Angular for frontend and Java with Spring for backend
You have strong technical skills in these areas: Angular, Java, Javascript, typescript, HTML, CSS, Camel, Spring, Springboot, Postgres, Oracle, Git/GitLab/Jenkins
You have strong knowledge of authentication and security mechanisms such as OAuth2, mTLS, JWT, and API security best practices
Knowledge on create and maintain reusable Angular libraries to optimize the development of future project
You have strong knowledge of Spring ecosystem including Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data, and Spring Cloud
You have good knowledge with dependency injection, AOP, and other core Spring concepts
DevOps experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
Knowledge with containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes)
You have a degree in software engineering, computer science or similar field
You have great analytical and problem-solving skills
Good understanding of UI/UX design principles
You have working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform and/or any Cloud Provider, with experience of hosting software solutions on the platform
You have experience of Agile working environment
You are organized and skilled in time-management
You are very accurate and demonstrate high attention to detail
You have a willingness to learn additional technologies and programming languages
You have sophisticated interpersonal and communication skills
Experience with PHP is nice-to-have
You are fluent in English, German is a plus
Perks & Benefits
At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
Hybrid Working Policy
Gift vouchers on the occasion of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours
Full access to the “Learning” platform
Shape the evolution
We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Azure Full Stack Developer (Angular/ .NET 8)
jobs.description:
Introduction
We are seeking an experienced Full Stack .NET / Angular Developer to support our team and contribute to the development of trading tools within the banking ecosystem. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with an interest in financial matters.
Role Responsibilities
Design, develop and enhance full-stack applications using .NET Core and Angular.
Adapt and integrate trading tools into the banking technical ecosystem.
Manage and reduce technical debt whilst ensuring alignment with architecture and information security guidelines.
Implement automated testing and monitoring to ensure robust day-to-day operations.
Work closely with business analysts, architects and QA teams.
Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Your Role And Responsibilities
As an Azure Cloud Full Stack Application Developer, you will work in a modern cloud-native environment, building solutions around Azure Native services, microservices-based modular designs, and API-driven microservices. You will collaborate with teams to deliver scalable and resilient backend microservices and rich UI applications using SPA or microfrontends.
Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include
Develop Scalable Microservices: Design and develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, bounded context of the business domain, and expose functionality via API and event interfaces.
Build Rich UI Applications: Develop rich UI applications using ReactJS or Angular, with a focus on Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends.
Implement Event-Driven Architectures: Develop event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and Azure Integration services like Azure Logic apps, Services Bus, Event Grid, and APIM.
Manage Azure Services: Run and manage services on Azure, including PaaS, content delivery networks, routing services, databases, and storage.
Implement DevSecOps Practices: Use Azure DevOps, GitHub, and Azure CI to implement continuous integration and delivery, and develop infrastructure as code using Terraform and ARM Templates.
Preferred Education
Master's Degree
Required Technical And Professional Expertise
Extensive experience in C# / .NET Core, Angular and REST APIs.
Proficiency in SQL (SQL Server, Oracle).
Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
A good understanding of software architecture principles.
Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
Proficiency in Containerization: Exposure to containerized workloads and serverless architectures, with knowledge of Azure Container Service, Azure Container Registry, and Azure Kubernetes Services.
Knowledge of Progressive Web Apps: Experience with developing progressive web applications using Single Page Applications (SPA) and microfrontends.
Familiarity with Purposed Databases: Exposure to purposed databases, including Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, and Azure Cache for Redis.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer - DealWise @ING Hubs Romania
jobs.description:
Discover ING Hubs Romania
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals.
We started out in 2015 as ING's software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from two locations: Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca.
Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data and Analytics Tech, Tech Foundation and Channels, Retail Core Banking and Architecture, and Global Products and Technology Services.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
Here's a sneak peak of what our colleagues say about working within ING Hubs Romania:
At ING, we're building the solutions of tomorrow, today | 80% of our colleagues in Romania agree
The Mission
We are seeking a skilled Frontend Developer with expertise in web components and JavaScript frameworks to join our dynamic team. As a Frontend Developer, you will play a crucial role in designing and implementing user interfaces for our web applications. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in frontend development, a deep understanding of web technologies, and a passion for creating seamless and visually appealing user experiences.
Your day to day
Frontend Development & Web Components
Develop scalable, maintainable, and reusable frontend applications.
Build modular Web Components using technologies such as Lit and modern JavaScript frameworks.
Translate UI/UX designs into responsive, high-quality user interfaces.
Contribute to shared component libraries and frontend standards.
Promote coding best practices, maintainability, and consistency across applications.
Microfrontend Architecture
Design, develop, and maintain solutions within a microfrontend architecture.
Ensure seamless integration between independently developed frontend applications.
Support modularization, scalability, and independent delivery of frontend capabilities.
Contribute to frontend architecture evolution and technical decision-making.
State Management
Implement and maintain scalable state management solutions using Redux or similar technologies.
Define effective patterns for data flow and asynchronous operations.
Ensure predictable application behavior and maintainable state structures.
Support communication across frontend modules and applications.
Accessibility & User Experience
Develop accessible user interfaces that comply with WCAG and WAI-ARIA guidelines.
Perform accessibility reviews and remediation activities.
Ensure compatibility with assistive technologies.
Advocate for inclusive design and accessibility best practices.
Performance Optimization
Optimize application performance and loading times.
Identify and resolve rendering bottlenecks, memory issues, and performance concerns.
Improve Core Web Vitals and overall user experience.
Continuously monitor and enhance frontend performance.
Testing & Quality Engineering
Create and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
Collaborate with QA engineers to ensure high-quality software delivery.
Support automated testing practices.
Participate in code reviews and quality improvement initiatives.
Azure DevOps & CI/CD
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
Automate build, testing, quality validation, and deployment processes.
Manage source control, build pipelines, release workflows, and artifacts.
Support deployment and release activities across multiple environments.
Troubleshoot build and deployment issues and drive continuous improvement of delivery processes.
AI-Assisted Development
Leverage tools such as GitHub Copilot and other AI-powered engineering assistants to improve productivity.
Use AI-assisted development techniques for coding, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.
Validate and review AI-generated outputs to ensure compliance with quality, security, and maintainability standards.
Contribute to the adoption of responsible AI-assisted development practices within the team.
Collaboration & Technical Leadership
Collaborate with developers, architects, designers, product owners, and QA engineers.
Participate in architectural discussions and technical design reviews.
Share knowledge and contribute to engineering communities and best practices.
Support junior and mid-level engineers through mentoring and technical guidance.
Promote a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence.
What you'll bring to the team
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience developing modern frontend applications.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Hands-on experience with Lit, React, Angular, Vue.js, or similar frontend frameworks.
Strong experience building and maintaining Web Components.
Solid experience with Redux or similar state management solutions.
Experience working within microfrontend architectures.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and asynchronous programming.
Experience implementing accessibility standards (WCAG, WAI-ARIA).
Experience with frontend testing frameworks and automated testing practices.
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps
Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Adobe Analytics
Experience using GitHub Copilot or similar AI-assisted development tools.
Strong understanding of frontend performance optimization techniques.
Experience with Git-based development workflows.
If you have a passion for building innovative and user-friendly interfaces using the latest web technologies, we would love to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of our web applications and providing users with exceptional digital experiences.
